text:
Jason Robertson is playing this season on a one-year, $12 million deal, and he can walk next summer. The trade talk has already started: Yahoo Sports relayed an insider floating a Robertson for Nikita Kucherov blockbuster, and an analyst quoted by NHL Trade Rumors called it "difficult to imagine" him signing long-term in Dallas.

He has 9 goals and 20 points in 18 games, including a hat trick against Washington on Nov. 3, and he is getting to the net: Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 90th percentile for chances from in front of it last season. His 9 goals come on 6.7 expected, a little hot but nothing wild.

Evolving-Hockey ranked him 14th among forwards in wins above replacement last season and credited him with driving play, 98th percentile after accounting for teammates and competition. Dallas has also scored 4.9 more goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice, so the assists may slow a touch.

Our projection has him between 32 and 50 goals, 40 in the middle. Every one of them now doubles as a sales pitch, to the Stars or to somebody else.
